name: Dayton
takeaway: Dayton's SOPEC program renewed in June 2026. The 100% renewable default is 10.691¢/kWh through June 2027, up from 8.71¢. A brown opt-down is 10.576¢. The AES Ohio standard offer is 10.856¢.
hook: Dayton's city program went from 8.71¢ to 10.691¢ in June, a 23% step, locked through June 2027.
notes: SOPEC member since 2021, supplier AEP Energy, billed by AES Ohio. Prior term 8.71¢ through June 2026. City page lists green 10.691¢ and brown 10.576¢ for the 12 months from June 2026 and the AES Ohio standard offer at 10.856¢. Reliability 0.88: city page, SOPEC page, and electricchoice.com agree on 10.691¢ (search summaries, pages not opened 2026-11-23).
